name: focus-permission-dialog
description: A permission dialog over FocusMatrixActivity drops window focus; dismissing it regains focus with no extra flush. NOTE: the sibling IME row is NOT here on purpose -- measured on Pixel 10 / API 37, a verifiably-open keyboard (dumpsys input_method -> mInputShown=true) never drops window focus, so there is nothing to automate.

steps.why: an already-granted permission returns with no dialog and therefore no focus loss
the activity purpose-built for the dialog focus-loss row
settle and let one foreground disk flush land as a positive control
the dialog appears and steals window focus
let the focus flush and its upload land while the dialog is up
dismiss; the regain must NOT flush again. BACK rather than tapping 'Don't allow' because a denial records a decision and two of them set USER_FIXED, after which no dialog ever appears again
